Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. F01271025
Sheriff’s File # 26002281
PLAINTIFF – Carrington Mortgage Services, LLC vs:
DEFENDANTS- Sean Allen Conover, et al.
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 11th day of January 2027
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Neptune, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Tax Lot: 7 Block: 4205 Located on the tax map of the Township of Neptune
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
204 Elm Drive Neptune, NJ 07753
Dimensions of Lot: 77'.87' x 100'
Nearest Cross Street: Pine Terrance
Plaintiff's upset bid is $378,369.88 in accordance with the requirements of Section 12 of P.L. 1995, c. 244 (C.2A:50-64) as amended.
The property is reported to be owner occupied.
Neptune Township holds a claim in the amount of $230.00 plus penalty for Sewer as of 10/05/2026.
The full legal description can be found in the Office of the Clerk of Monmouth County in Mortgage Book OR-9433 Page 6431.
SUPERIOR INTEREST (if any): Any and all easements, covenants, restrictions and reservations of record; Any set of facts which an accurate survey and inspection would disclose; All unpaid municipal taxes, assessments and liens: Any unpaid assessments and any outstanding tax sale certificate; Rights of any party in possession/rights protected by the NJ Anti-eviction Act; All Local, County, State and Federal ordinances and regulations; Any CONDOMINIUM ASSOCIATION LIEN GRANTED PRIORITY PURSUANT BY N.J.S.A. 46:B-21B; Any outstanding Condominium, PUD or Homeowner Association dues or fees; Rights of the United States of America, if any; The property is SOLD in its “AS IS” condition; Purchaser shall be responsible for Sheriff’s costs, commission, deed and recording fees and realty transfer fees.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $371,335.64.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: November 4, 2026
Powers Kirn, LLC
308 Harper Drive Suite 210
P.O. Box 848
Moorestown, NJ 08057
856-802-1000
